page.layout: One page of text, verse in two stanzas-blocks with numbered poems (14 and 15) and French/Latin mixed lines; running head at top centre with page number at top right; signature mark at lower right of text block. No margin notes.

main_text.p:
Nixus vagantis remigio globi
Quem fluctus unda, quem rotat impetus
Venti furentis: se per omne
Incolumem fore credit æquor.

14. Quand le iour fils du Soleil, &c.
Quum Sol fugatis exoriens diem
Reddit tenebris, quum iubar aureum
Diffundit, obiectîque montis
Verticibus rutilum renidet:
Non finiendæ lucis amœnitas
Sperata mentem recreat: horridas
Præsentis æui nam tenebras
Perpetuum iubar insequetur.
15. Orfeure, taille moy vne boule bien ronde, &c.

p.i:
Præsentis æui quæris imaginem?
Pictor rotundum pinge, precor, globum,
Intus canatum, quem furentes
Vsque ferant rapiântque venti,
Fronti venustæ cui decus addito,
Quantum arte possis eximia memor:
Hunc ornet omnis fusa circum
Copia frugum, & opes benignæ.
Insculpe tales dehinc titulos globo.
FALLACIS æui conspicitis fugam,
Pictáque fruges, nec manere
Quæ vary rapit aura venti.

page.notes: Lines of the first stanza and the "Quum Sol" stanza are set in italic; the French lines of headings 14 and 15 are in roman. "Intus canatum" and "vary" and "Pictáque" appear as printed; "canatum" likely printing error for "caelatum" and "vary" for "vario" — left as printed. Section mark of the final signature "K. ij." read with some uncertainty ("ij" possibly "ij." ). Two-line marginal ornaments and catchwords are absent.
